horoscopes.horoscope: Today will be an industrious day. The stars foretell that you may visit a historical place, or perhaps a museum. However, Ganesha says, you may need to pay a little attention to your health. If such is the case, it would be better to take the evening off for yourself. You will meet a happy-go-lucky person today, foresees Ganesha. Since you’re in a good mood, you would want to socialise with a group or a club. Someone from opposite sex will be attracted by your cheerful personality. When you meet them, you may say or do something for which they applaud you. Feeling low since morning, you may avoid going to office and just lie down in bed. However, Ganesha advises you to finish urgent work on hand, and thereafter spend rest of the day in the company of friends or family. You hardly stand a chance to earn extra penny through any source. Ganesha feels that you will not even be in a mood to put in efforts to earn extra money today, and will instead just want to relax. You will be professional and will focus completely on pending tasks. Thus, you will get ready to take up new challenges. Your fearlessness is the key to success. Your confidence, sincerity and determination will help you achieve some important projects in the office, says Ganesha.

Today, Ganesha sees your mind shifting from your professional affairs and drifting, time and again, towards your home and family. You are likely to return home early and get happily engrossed in discussing pressing domestic issues with your family members. This will possibly be followed by a festive evening filled with fun and laughter. You’re going to devote the whole day to your home and family and will be inclined to do little else. You may plan to surprise your family and friends. So you may call up your friends and relatives and arrange a get-together. You will be appreciated for this invitation. You will love to see smile and joy in the face of others. You will celebrate this wonderful evening in a joyful mood. Ganesha says that you shall politely interact with one and all today. As a result, your colleagues, associates, friends, relatives and family will feel very glad. Your positive vibes will spread around, and they shall also behave nicely with you. You will just have to remain satisfied with what you are earning in regular course and that should put you at ease too. Putting in too much effort or devoting much time to anything else wouldn’t work in your favour. Keep your nerve cool under pressure today, warns Ganesha. You will be able to accomplish your tasks only if you are in a balanced state of mind. New opportunities will call upon you to use your presence of mind and transform thoughts into action.

There is a possibility of conflicts brewing at your home today. The demands made by your family members will increase and you may struggle to cope to meet them. This could make you ill-tempered. You will encounter large expenses in meeting these demands. You need to cut down on your expenses and increase your savings, says Ganesha. An innocent rendezvous with your beloved may turn into a sizzling adventure only if you make the right moves! Just open up to make yourself feel comfortable in front of your sweetheart. You can also please him or her by singing the favourite romantic number from your heart, suggests Ganesha. You are going to enjoy both good health and mood today. You may not be very energetic but you will be feeling more settled and at ease. Your work performance will be good. You may also wish to eat something of your choice today. You shall come across new opportunities to earn more money today. You get more business, find a new job or negotiate your salary to get a better deal. Use your funds sparingly to save more. A technical task will definitely confuse you today. Let it be else you may end up losing yourself in the maze. Finishing off something simple would be a clever idea, suggests Ganesha. You will get the things done if you work for the sake of pleasure, fun or excitement, assures Ganesha.

You can improve your finances with you mental capabilities. Ganesha says that you will get success in both private life and career. You will be entrusted many tasks and responsibilities. Yet by evening, you will spend time in your pursuits. Congratulations! An overdose of kisses and hugs may come your way. Your sweetheart will be impressed by your willingness to compromise on issues that were a thorn in the neck till yesterday. Talk to your partner so as to make him/her feel glad, suggests Ganesha. You may not be able to command today but you will do well if you just ‘follow’. You could as well feel increased anxiety about things going wrong. Keep your anxiety level in control, otherwise your health and humour both will be affected. If someone offers you a very good business or shows you plan to double your money in a very short time – do not trust the person or that scheme without doing your own research. Ganesha has already planned a fantastic day for you. Your mind is likely to be tension free and focused. Heavy workloads will not bother you at all. You will achieve your targets easily at work, without missing a single clue, foresees Ganesha.

You may have arguments with your family members today. You need to adopt an accomodating attitude today, since it is not a very promising day for you. Otherwise nothing may go in your favour. You will have to work harder than usual in the office, says Ganesha. You’ll forget all your worries at the sight of your lover, which will send your adrenaline rushing. Gear up for some love and feeling. When it comes to romance, you want to see your lover’s adventure spirit. Your wild mind is likely to stimulate your sweetheart’s fantasy, feels Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you should keep all the worries aside and stay focussed on what you ‘have’ to do. Instead of getting stressed, believe in yourself and your efforts. You could experience health problems today, so you should better beware. You shall be averse to buy anything of an inferior quality today, and you shall aim to purchase only the high end things in your quest for perfection. You may want to invest money in maintaining your house. A great day awaits you! If you aren’t satisfied with your salary, which hasn’t budged in the past few years, then it’s time to voice your concern to your boss or HR head. Important meetings are also on the cards, says Ganesha.

Ganesha predicts that your writing skills will possibly help you vent your feelings without offending others. You will successfully complete your pending assignments. Great success will knock at your door in anything and everything you undertake today, predicts Ganesha. You need to come close to your sweetheart to understand his/her feelings, foresees Ganesha. You will be able to find a better solution of issues by yourself. Be kind, sympathetic and trustworthy with your loved one and you will discover true love and enjoy a romantic life. You will carry on the entire day with greater enthusiasm. Your energy level will hardly drop today. Towards end of the day, you will be in a mood to relax, meet friends or enjoy good time with those who adore you. If your budget permits it, you will buy it – or else, you will wait for your financial situation to improve. No one will be able to provoke you to spend money without any logic. You will have a satisfactory day at work today, foresees Ganesha. Your amicable attitude will promise healthy relationships with peers and this will certainly add to your productivity. Moreover, you are brimming with optimism. Decision making will give you sheer confidence.

Ganesha says you will spend time with your family members by putting them above other commitments. There may be plans made to go out for dinner or for a short excursion with them. Ganesha says that the health of a close relative maybe a cause of concern for you today. Everything may not be hunky dory in your personal life. A disagreement with your partner may affect your relationship, foresees Ganesha. You may get deviated from a certain factor but you need to sort out the problem by yourself, says Ganesha. You will be full of energy today and you will use this energy properly. Your positive energy will help lead tasks to important points. Despite remaining active and busy today, you may not face any health issues. Your work output will be good. Ganesha advises you to maintain a good rapport with superiors in other organizations. People in authority can really be very helpful in finding you some good opportunities earn more money. Creativity is your passion, whereas language and communication are your power. You will be armed with the best use of these two important elements. You will greatly impress your colleagues and superiors with your creative inputs. This will certainly add brownie points to your image in the company.

You nearly emerge as a superhero today, as you have the knack of balancing home and work just perfectly. Intellectual discussions and brainstorming with peers would provide food for thought today. You may look forward to merry-making and soiree with family and friends in the evening. With things moving at a normal pace, harmony should prevail in your love life, foresees Ganesha. You will feel safe and comfortable in the arms of your lover. With long-term commitment on the cards, you will be having a positive period, foresees Ganesha. You will have lot of energy today. You are suggested not to plan your day. Rather you should let it be and react as per the circumstances. Health wise, you have a good day on hand, so it has to be utilized properly. Ganesha feels that you will be lucky in financial matters today. Your decisions regarding finances will be very firm and you shall be very rigid on them once you have taken the decisions. Avoid getting too emotional about work today. Ganesha advises you to maintain a professional distance and view projects objectively. You don’t need to feel disappointed even though you aren’t able to work efficiently as Ganesha feels that it’s just a passing phase.

You are in a mood to spend money of home décor, paintings or artefacts. Go ahead, and decorate your home. Ganesha foresees success on your cards today. Workplace has never been scuh an interesting place before. Planning and implementation will make your day easier. It’s caution and tact that will help you sail smoothly on the personal front. Ganesha feels that it’s your generosity that adds value to your love life. Your honest and truthful nature will come to the fore. You are in a mood to compromise in your love relationship. As far as possible, do not argue with anyone in your workplace and residence today. This could lead to disputes and disturb the work or home atmosphere, foresees Ganesha. Moreover, your energy level may decrease and adversely affect your health. You are advised to remain composed about your current financial condition and hope for the improvement in the future. Until you learn to control expenses, you won’t have peace of mind. Considering the number of files pending in your computer, Ganesha suggests it’s the time to pull up your socks and get down to work. However, taking breaks at intervals will keep your mind stress-free. Spending time with superiors and colleagues and planning work styles will reduce your stress.

You will have heard of many emotional fools who let sentiments rule their lives. Try not be one of them, and if it’s too difficult a task, at least pretend not to be one of them, for Ganesha says going by your feelings can leave you at a low ebb. In other words, your feelings can come in the way of your success. A solution to this problem is to remain dispassionate and let the opportunist think you are a hard nut to crack. If you are still unhappy and feel that some negative factors are haunting you, listen to Michael Jackson’s “Hold my hand” with your soulmate. You will confidently be able to hold your hands with your darling and attract all emotional comforts and inner peace that nothing else can. From the beginning of this rather boring day, you shall find yourself in low spirits. Simple tasks may appear to be tough. Only attend urgent work, and do not undertake difficult tasks, else you may get tired very soon, observes Ganesha. Generally you are calculative when it comes to money matters, and you spend only after thinking many times. However, today, you are likely to be influenced by other people’s opinions and thoughts. This may be a stressful day for you, says Ganesha. It’s not just the physical stress but your emotion may also play havoc. There will be huge responsibilities and your boss will expect a lot from you. Keep your nerve cool under pressure and avoid getting hot-tempered over trivial matters, advises Ganesha.

If you are an astrologer, doctor or a spiritual leader, today is a favourable day for you. Those who may want to challenge you must reconsider the thought of testing your strengths, says Ganesha. Doing charity work, helping the needy, and working for humanitarian causes give you a feeling of contentment. Today, it will be one of those extremely fulfilling days. Your chilled out personality may not be appreciated by your partner. Therefore, you need to be a little more caring and sensitive to your sweetheart, feels Ganesha. One thoughtless remark may leave lasting scars. As responsibilities are on the cards, you tend to feel together, foresees Ganesha. As today you are going to be very busy, so Ganesha suggests you to be bit more careful about health. You may need to pay attention to many things at once, which may keep your brain cells active all the time. Ganesha feels that today the planets indicate routine expenses and routine income. No fluctuations are foreseen on the financial front. If you have taken loans in the past, you may try to finish them off ASAP. You are hungry for knowledge and fired up to learn new techniques, and today’s the right day for that. Go ahead and pursue a course if you wish. Ganesha says it is an investment that will pay off in the long run. Your creativity will boost your productivity.

Today will be a hectic day for you. Most of your time will be spent in making your relationships on the business as well as the personal front more meaningful. You will likely find yourself attending social events. There is also the possibility that you will attend some religious ritual today. Apart from this, nothing substantial is likely to occur today, says Ganesha. A wonderful time is on the cards for the lovers. If you are single and in love, then this is an excellent day to propose that scintillating someone. With romance in the air, married ones will find pleasure in their partner’s company. On this wonderful day, expect your health to be on the positive side. Moreover, your creative abilities will come to the fore. You should preferably consume fresh fruit juices or health drinks daily to maintain your fitness level, advises Ganesha. Today, you will spend money like water on entertainment and pleasure. For you, it will be very important to be happy at heart and there may not be logical thoughts behind your purchases or expenses. You are in a mood to advise others but you may not feel confident enough. Ganesha feels that you need to hone your skills. This will also push you ahead on your path to professional success. You can achieve greater things by mixing your creative instincts with technical knowledge,
